summary: Phase 0.4 security-isolation harness verified correct and complete: S1-S9 assertions are meaningful (catch calendar leaks, missing Bearer challenges, and cross-client overlap), the harness exits 1 against current production and 0 against compliant behavior, reports the correct production-fix phase map (S1-S5→Phase 3, S6-S8→Phase 4, S9→Phase 2), and is a pure HTTP client with no lab-binary dependency. All four Phase 0 verifiers pass.
important_context: Negative-token cases S1-S5 are driven in isolation (valid signature, single wrong claim) only via the mock's /_test/token/mint hook; against a real production server the harness falls back to tampering the JWT payload, which also invalidates the signature, so individual claim checks are not exercised in isolation against production.

assertFailClosed is intentionally lenient: it passes on a 200 carrying a JSON-RPC error (no calendar content) as well as a 401 with a Bearer challenge; it only fails on a 200 with calendar content or a 401 lacking a Bearer challenge.
